web_ui.title: Purchase review
web_ui.description: Review the purchase assessment, supplier evidence and terms that still need checking.

starter_questions: Can I try the fictional offline quote comparison?
What purchase brief and must-have requirements do you need?
Why did this option lead, and what could change the comparison?

setup_guide.introduction: Try the fictional workstation quotes to see how price and missing terms affect a purchase decision. For your own comparison, tell me what you need to buy and what it must achieve.

sample.title: Simulation: GPU workstation quotes
sample.description: Compare three fictional vendors’ workstation quotes offline.
sample.expected_output: A 36-month cost comparison showing how the missing quote and review requirements affect the choice.

values.inputs.payload.item_description: Compare five GPU workstations from three fictional suppliers for sensitive internal datasets.

real.introduction: Describe the purchase and the outcome you need. Include a firm budget or deadline if you have one.

fields.label: What do you need to buy, and what must it achieve?
fields.description: Include quantity and non-negotiable requirements. Add a firm budget or deadline if you have one; say when a detail is still unknown.

fields.label: Supporting documents folder
fields.description: Optional quotes, requirements, research links, spreadsheets, PDFs, or images for this purchase.

fields.label: Maximum all-in budget
fields.description: Optional purchase ceiling, including tax, shipping and deployment. Leave it unset for an exploratory comparison; affordability will remain unverified.

fields.label: Location
fields.description: The delivery, use, property, or travel location that affects availability and cost.

fields.label: Priorities
fields.description: List the factors the comparison should favor, one per line.

fields.label: Must-have requirements
fields.description: Only non-negotiable requirements belong here. Keep preferences in Priorities; a failed must-have excludes an option.

fields.label: Cost assumptions
fields.description: Planning estimates for the cost horizon, use, labor, downtime, tax and resale value. Review them when interpreting costs; these are not supplier facts.

fields.label: Output folder
fields.description: Where the completed purchasing packet should be copied.

fields.label: Saved instructions
fields.description: Manage explicit preferences and working rules in Chat > Memory. Applies to future runs.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll compare requirements, known costs and missing terms so you can see which options are ready for review.
run_guidance.report_ready: Expand the report and start with the Decision brief to see which purchase terms still need checking.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open procurement_manager_report.md and read the Decision brief before comparing the quoted costs.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open the purchase review and compare the quote evidence behind the next decision.
